title: Chapter 117 Compensation
content:
Chapter 117 Compensation

"What they asked for is ultimately up to you, right?" Wang Shuo said with a hint of unhappiness in his tone.

"Haha... What, you're not convinced?" Mr. Zach laughed unabashedly when he saw Wang Shuo's silent expression.

"If they want to release a mission, they need to pay a certain price. This is your reward for this victory."

Lord Zach directly delivered a palm-sized object in front of Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo saw this small fountain-like thing floating on his chest.

I felt a little surprised in my heart, but when I thought that Master Zac has great magical powers, and this little ability is just a drizzle, I felt relieved.

"For me?" Wang Shuo asked tentatively.

"This is what the Iron-Blooded Lord compensates you for."

Wang Shuo stretched out his right hand and took this small jade-like fountain object into his hand.

The system prompt sounds.

At this time, Wang Shuo was sure of one thing. The system prompt and Lord Zach were not the same thing.

The system is like a program, executed mechanically, and Lord Zach is more like an administrator, or even the creator of the game, with supreme authority.

[Fountain of Life: Placed within the territory, each person will recover 1% of their health per minute. It can produce 1 drop of "water of life" every day, instantly restore 10,000 health points, and clear all negative status. 】

Wang Shuo's calm expression could no longer remain tense.

Stop pretending, let me show my cards, I just haven’t seen the world.

Wang Shuo's eyes widened, he couldn't believe his eyes at all, and he forgot to breathe for a moment.

"This, is this really for me?"

Wang Shuo had a lump in his throat, and it was difficult to speak.

Really, this prop is too perverted.

As long as you stay in the village, you can recover your health at a rate of 1%. When you defend the city in the future, you will not only occupy the advantageous location, but as long as the people you lead are not killed instantly, you will be able to return to a completely new state after a while. , participate in the battle.

Seeing Wang Shuo's shocked look, Master Zach finally smiled.

It was as if his evil taste was satisfied.

He narrowed his eyes slightly and smiled slightly: "I am in a good mood today. I can reward you with a question. Any question will do."

When Wang Shuo heard the news, there was no doubt that there was a thunder in his mind.

For a time, his thoughts were complicated and various thoughts came to him one after another.

This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. What question should I ask?

His thoughts were numb, and he was caught in hesitation and entanglement.

"Can I return to Blue Star?"

It seems that this question has no value for future development.

After arriving here, Wang Shuo gradually began to adapt to this kind of life, and even felt a little eager for it.

May I ask about the situation in Dahuaiyu?

It seems that as time goes by, I will be able to understand this problem sooner or later.

After thinking for a long time, he had a plan in his mind.

"What's the next step?" Wang Shuo calmed down and said slowly.

There was another question in his mind, "What is the purpose of this game?"

But even if you know that you can't live, it doesn't make much sense.

"Smart kid."

Master Zach's lips curled up into a wicked smile.

"You can ask the remnant soul in your body this question? Why did you choose to ask me?"

Lord Zach, before answering directly, asked Wang Shuo.

"Lord Zach, all of this is under your control. The process can change at any time. You cannot completely trust a remnant soul. If you make a mistake in judging the situation, you will lose everything."

"Very good, I like this answer very much." Lord Zach nodded appreciatively.
